info.title: Mland Product Management API
info.description: FE-02 draft technical contract updated 2026-10-24. User confirmed MEMBER/STAFF/MANAGER/ADMIN, Admin-provisioned authority, defaults, retention, Cloudinary and shared authentication using FE-01/Member Profile 003 primitives: verified bearer for API, fixed eight-hour web sessions without sliding renewal, revocation/status checks and CSRF. Internal capabilities remain required per action; a Member cookie grants no internal authority. MFA method/recovery and privileged-auth assurance contract remain an identity-owned design dependency before enabling management. FE-08 and identity/Cloudinary adapters are implementation dependencies, not evidence of an implemented service. See interfaces.md for state, reference-guard and audit rules.

bearerIdentity.bearerFormat: Backend-verified identity token; local status/capability required for management.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Actor/action scoped command key. Same key+same normalized payload replays; different payload returns 409. Current authorization is still required.

Id.description: Positive signed BIGINT rendered as decimal string; reject values above 9223372036854775807.

Amount.description: Exact positive whole VND, up to DECIMAL(19,0) representation; no exponent, fraction or leading zero. Technical range, no additional business cap ratified.

Quantity.description: Exact nonnegative integer quantity; technical DECIMAL(19,0) range.

url.description: Same-origin eligible product-media endpoint; no private provider key.

ProductCreate.description: Distinct configured sizes, positions and usable owned media references; no client SKU, engraving or applied price.

ReviewApproval.description: Every configured variant and matching proposal revision exactly once; review plus all decisions commit atomically.

CategoryCreate.description: New category active=true is user-confirmed. Globally unique normalized name includes inactive categories.

ManagementVariant.description: A quantity snapshot must be authoritative; if required hold data cannot be verified, return 503 rather than omitting fields or substituting zero. A newly created never-public variant can have a proven zero hold context.

ManagementProduct.description: Deleted products are absent from ordinary management reads. Accepted-transaction historical access is through the trusted internal FE-08 contract, not this response.

ActionResult.description: Confirmed minimal command result; retain at least five years from commit without full request or credentials. Replay still requires current authorization.
